thread:
maya: quick sync — we need to lock prioritization for GA readiness. Customers are pushing lower-latency SLAs and tiered commercial terms. What can we realistically commit to for initial GA vs phased rollouts?

alex: +1. proposal: phase SLAs by tier so we don't block GA. e.g. Bronze = best-effort, Silver = 99.9, Gold = 99.95. Dedicated pools for Gold.

tom: agree on tiering. operational note: Gold requires a documented handback + 24/7 oncall for first 90 days. who's owning the runbook? @eng-sre needs to confirm capacity commitments.

luis: pricing implications: if Gold uses Dedicated pools, we need a reserved-capacity surcharge and burst pricing. finance wants explicit quota and overage examples in docs.

maya: actionable split: (1) SLA definitions + acceptance tests, (2) docs + pricing pages, (3) monitoring/dashboards + alerts, (4) support/runbooks. propose owners per item below.

sam: suggested owners: SLA/tests = alex + eng-ml; docs/pricing = luis + product-marketing; monitoring = tom + eng-platform; runbook/oncall = eng-sre (TBD).

alex: SLA acceptance tests: we can create a stress harness that runs 10k requests across p95/p99 windows. quick example command: `./stress-test --routes predict --qps 200 --dur 30m` — output will drive SLA baseline.

luis: for pricing page we need concrete examples. draft snippet: 
```
Gold (99.95%) — Reserved GPU pool + $X/month + $Y/1M tokens
Silver (99.9%) — Shared capacity burst eligible + $A/month + $B/1M tokens
Bronze — Hosted best-effort, pay-as-you-go only
```

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: /deploy docs-site to prod at 2024-06-14T10:00Z — staging preview available.

tom: monitoring checklist: per-route latency histograms, token-cost per-call metric, SLA burn-rate alert if p99 > threshold for 15m. dashboard owners should be single-click linkable from runbook.

maya: docs checklist (minimal GA): SLA page, pricing examples, quickstart for Dedicated, troubleshooting runbook, billing support flow, escalation matrix. Anything else?

alex: add a short regression eval for quality under quantized models — we shouldn't promise identical quality without the caveat. link to eval harness in docs.

luis: commercial ask: we should offer a 30-day pilot for Enterprise with a temporary elevated SLA while we validate. need legal + finance signoff.

maya: OK — next steps: owners to comment on this thread with a binary commit by EOD Friday. I'll consolidate into a launch-criteria checklist and circulate to GTM. :thumbsup:

tom: noted — I'll add the dashboard templates and a runbook stub before EOD Thursday.

alex: will get the stress harness and baseline numbers in staging by Friday.

luis: I'll draft the pricing examples and pilot contract template, pinging finance/legal.

maya: thanks — meeting to finalize criteria Wed morning 11am PT. invite on calendar.
